operations.name: Ken Rippetoe

expected.name: Ken Rippetoe
expected.description: Ken Rippetoe was a Catholic Worker in Rock Island, Illinois and a participant in the March 28, 1986 Silo Plowshares action at missile silos controlled by Whiteman Air Force Base. He was convicted of destruction of government property and conspiracy. A contemporary prisoner roster lists him in Duluth, Minnesota; the previously assigned USP Marion location is unsupported.
expected.body:
Separate Silo Plowshares custody episodes

The original Nuclear Resister reports March 28, 1986 arrest and recognizance release that evening, then posttrial jailing for Rippetoe's refusal of bond conditions. Original arrest report; trial continuation. The movement chronology dates conviction June 27, posttrial release July 8, and sentencing August 22. These are separate from the later prison term.

A September 23, 1986 press release reproduced in Insurgent dates actual prison entry September 15. Its roster lists Ken Rippetoe, register 03787-045, at Duluth. Original entry report; original register/location roster. The official BOP locator, searched by that register, returns Kenneth B Rippetoe and no BOP custody as of June 5, 1987. This replaces the approximate June report, not a claim that probation ended. No identified reusable portrait has yet been established.
